description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

Trideum Corporation is hiring a Junior Software Engineer to collaborate with senior team members on designing, developing, testing, and maintaining software applications. The role also supports code quality, software development processes, and professional growth.
Junior Software Engineer writing software and assisting with testing, debugging, and code reviews

Responsibilities:
• Collaborate with senior engineers to create and implement software solutions
• Write clean, efficient code following coding standards
• Assist in testing and debugging software
• Participate in code reviews and provide constructive feedback
• Stay updated on industry trends and incorporate new technologies
• Contribute to the improvement of software development processes and methodologies

Requirements:
• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field
• 0-2 years experience in software development
• U.S. citizenship and an active secret clearance
• Proficiency in programming languages like Java, C++, or Python
• Understanding of the software development lifecycle
• Strong problem-solving skills
• Excellent communication and teamwork skills
• Capacity to excel in a fast-paced environment
